title: Coral Island
shortDescription: Coral Island is a vibrant, laid-back farm sim reimagined with multiplayer! Experience enchanting island life at your own pace: farm with friends, nurture animals, build relationships, hang out with a diverse cast of characters, and dive into the magical Merfolk Kingdom.
zhShortDescription: 热带海岛农场模拟，耕种、潜水、恋爱、修复珊瑚礁。
description: It’s time to leave big-city life in Pokyo behind and start a new chapter of your life on Coral Island! Be who you want and create the idyllic farm of your dreams, where you’ll tend crops, nurture animals, and build a bond with the natural world around you. Help revitalize the nearby town and its surrounding coral reefs, and forge relationships with a vibrant community of more than 70 fellow people who call Coral Island home. Farm. Decorate. Craft. Explore. Relax. Your future—and the future of Coral Island—is what you make of it. Build Your Dream Farm Transform your overrun land on Coral Island into a lush and lively dreamscape—you decide what to build, what crops to grow, and which animals you’d like to tend. zhDescription: 《珊瑚岛》是一款热带海岛风格的农场模拟游戏。继承荒废农场后，在岛上耕种作物、饲养动物、与村民建立关系。独特之处在于海洋生态——潜水探索珊瑚礁、清理海洋垃圾。3D画面精美，是星露谷玩家不可错过的选择。
metaDescriptionEn: Coral Island review — tropical farming sim with diving and coral restoration. NPCs, romance, exploration.
metaDescriptionZh: 《珊瑚岛》Steam 评测与介绍 — 热带农场模拟，潜水探索与珊瑚修复。NPC 好感度、恋爱系统、海底世界。

topReviews.review:
As someone who was really disappointed with the state of farming sims and was going back and forth for debating whether Coral Island is worth a try, I hope this review will help you to give this game a try.

And yes, I know that every farming sim gets compared to Stardew and players (and developers) are tired of this comparison. However, I’m not comparing the games themselves, I’m comparing the feeling of playing it. 
This is the first farming sim that made me feel the way I felt during my first SDV playthrough. A feeling that is incredibly hard to replicate given that a lot of farming sims I …
topReviews.zh_review: 作为一个对农场模拟现状失望、反复纠结珊瑚岛值不值得试的人，希望这条评价能帮到你。我知道每个农场模拟都会被拿来和星露谷比，玩家和开发者都烦了。但我不比较游戏本身，我比较的是玩的感觉。这是第一款让我找到第一次玩星露谷时那种感觉的农场模拟——那种感觉极难复制，因为太多农场游戏只是机械缝合。珊瑚岛不是。

topReviews.review:
I really like this game, but after putting 600 hours into one save, they released an update that destroyed 600 hours of progress because saves don't work from one update to the next. 

For a game out of Early Access (supposedly) where you simply wouldn't anticipate that, this killed my desire to play. I just gave up. I don't want to start all over again after putting in so much effort, ykwim. 

Just seeing that there's now a huge additional roadmap further removes incentives to play, because I'll just wind up losing my save during those updates as well. If they fixed this, it would be a fantas…
topReviews.developer_response:
Hello Shayne,
We’re truly sorry to hear this, especially after 600 hours of progress. We completely understand how devastating that must feel.

We previously had a public beta testing branch, and unfortunately, a hotfix released there affected some saves on the live branch as well. Did you happen to switch to the beta testing branch at any point? If so, your save may not actually be lost, and there may still be a way to restore it.

Here is how to restore your save file:

1. Open %localappdata%\ProjectCoral\Saved\SaveGames\LegacySaves in Windows Explorer
2. Copy all the files from that folder into the SaveGames folder (one level up)
3. In the SaveGames folder, delete the World_[number] folder and SaveManifest.sav
4. Launch the game - your save should now appear in the live build

If you run into any difficulties or your save does not appear, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at support@stairwaygames.com, and we will do our best to help.

We are truly sorry for the frustration this has caused.
topReviews.zh_review: 我真的很喜欢这个游戏，但在我600小时的一个存档上，他们出了个更新直接把600小时进度毁了——因为存档在版本间不兼容。对于一个'正式版'游戏来说这根本不该发生。这直接浇灭了我的热情，放弃了。花了那么多心血后不想从头再来。看到现在还有巨大的路线图更是劝退——因为我的存档还会被毁。如果修好这个问题，这会是一款超棒的游戏。

topReviews.review: Otimo jogo de cuidar de uma fazenda, muito bonitinho e tem muitas coisas diferente de stardew valley, estou gostando muito, tem muita coisa para fazer e descobrir,  parece que ainda vai ter muita coisa incrivel em novos updates. otimo jogo
topReviews.zh_review: 很棒的农场经营游戏，非常可爱，和星露谷有很多不同的东西，我非常喜欢，有太多事情可以做和发现。看起来未来还会有更多令人期待的内容更新。好游戏。

whyPlay: Coral Island is what happens when a farming sim decides to be ambitious. Beyond the usual crops and romance, you get diving, coral restoration, bug catching, and an entire merfolk kingdom to befriend. The art direction is gorgeous — think Stardew Valley with a tropical 3D makeover. It's still growing through updates, but the foundation is already one of the strongest in the genre.
whyPlayZh: 《珊瑚岛》是一个农场模拟敢于做大梦的结果。在常规种田恋爱之外，你还有潜水、珊瑚修复、捕虫和一个完整的人鱼王国可以交朋友。美术方向惊艳——就当是星露谷做了热带 3D 改造。还在持续更新中成长，但底子已经是同类型里最扎实的之一。
